newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sell brisk at $69.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sell brisk at $69.00 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Inquiry and demand good. Sales confirmed on 14,800 slaughter steers and 9,300 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date, 70,500 head confirmed including 14600 head or about 21 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1300 lbs mostly 1150-1225 lbs 69.00. Dressed basis - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 112.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 990-1200 lbs mostly 1025-1100 lbs 69.00, one pen 68.50.
